name: io.github.NicolasPrimeau/artel
title: Artel
description: Your fleet's smart notepad — one that learns. You and every agent you run write into one pad; a note written once comes back when it's relevant. A background archivist merges, connects and retires notes so the pad improves on its own. What one agent learns, the rest already know. Self-hosted.

artel_host.description: Host of YOUR self-hosted Artel instance (e.g. artel.example.com). There is no public instance — Artel holds your fleet's memory, so you run it.
